headline: Silver Prices on India's MCX Fall Below Psychological 2 Lakh/Kg Threshold
summary: Silver futures on India's Multi Commodity Exchange (MCX) experienced a sharp drop on Friday, sliding below the key psychological level of Rs 2,00,000 per kilogram ahead of the festive season.
why: India is one of the world's largest consumers of physical precious metals, where local exchange pricing heavily influences seasonal jewelry and investment demand.

impacts.name: Silver
impacts.why: Sellers pushed local exchange prices below key support ahead of India's festive shopping period.
